articles.summary: Now in its third year, the Data-Driven Corrections Awards celebrate the corrections departments using data and technology to drive outcomes for staff, incarcerated people, and the communities they return to. This year’s winners had the willingness to do the hard work, and the optimism to believe that they could make things better for their staff and the people they serve.
articles.title: Hard Work and Optimism: Celebrating the 2026 Winners of the Data-Driven Corrections Awards
